# Handbook template

Follow the [authoring workflow](../handbook/documentation.md#creating-a-document). Adapt headings to the subject and
remove optional sections when they add no useful information.

## Purpose

Describe the reader's task or concept, its scope, and any prerequisites.

## Topic

Replace this heading with sections for the subject: architecture and data flows, reference settings and defaults, or
procedure steps with commands and expected results. Link authoritative code or configuration.

## Examples (optional)

Add examples that help the reader apply the explanation or procedure.

## Limitations (optional)

Describe applicable constraints, failure symptoms, and recovery guidance. Label planned behavior and unknowns.
